hashMethod: sha256 of sorted relative dist paths, NUL, contents, NUL
conditions: macOS arm64 / Node v24.21.0. Isolated HOME and private tmux. Short runs: identical fixture v4, 12 seconds of appends, 15 seconds idle, 8 MiB per rollout, 59 append batches. Samples were run sequentially: candidate 1/5 HUD, repeat candidate 5 HUD, rebuilt baseline 1/5 HUD. Long run: 5 HUD, 12 seconds of appends, 750 seconds idle, 8-second wake deadline.
limitations: Single samples and one candidate repeat; host scheduling and GC can vary. RSS includes shared pages; summed peaks are not simultaneous. CPU excludes subprocess CPU.
The long run overlapped part of the isolated test suite. It validates behavior and resource release, not a controlled performance comparison or absence of leaks over hours.

The long-run process predates the final backlog-fairness amendment in overview urgency. Its no-backlog fixture does not exercise that branch; the final amendment is covered by a failing-then-passing regression, all 159 test scripts and the final short benchmarks. Candidate build hash describes the final short/runtime render build.

Worker retirement requires 30 seconds without a query, not 30 seconds without user input. Deep-idle binding backoff is gradual; the first inactive worker samples appeared around 707 seconds from startup.
Only local macOS / Node 24 was run in this change. Node 20/22, Linux containers and 20-HUD final-code load remain unmeasured.
